caption:
The video captures a single frosted-glass votive candle holder seated at the center of a polished metallic enclosure. A small upright flame burns above the wick, keeping the upper rim pale while the lower half glows from within. Mirrored side walls cast two duplicate images of the vessel, each with a bright flame reflection, and a perforated metal panel stands behind the holder.

The internal glow drifts over time, starting as a saturated green that fills the base and lower side reflections. As it gradually cools toward cyan and then blue, the left reflection shifts first while the right lingers in green. By the later moments the central vessel and its left reflection read blue, the right still holding a teal cast.

The flame flickers subtly, varying in height and width yet staying centered and lit. Slight handheld jitter shifts the framing, without obvious pan or zoom. The mirrored reflections track the same hue change as the central object, echoing the shifting glow rather than separate lights.
relations: The central votive's internal green glow gradually shifts toward cyan and blue.
The left mirrored reflection changes hue first while the right lingers in green.
The upright flame flickers subtly in height and width, remaining centered.
Side reflections track the central vessel's hue change, echoing the shifting glow.
